summary: Start room is an energy gate (exit window 50-110 u above the floor; WR pumps in the east halfpipe first). Baseline, 4x novelty and energy-shaping-everywhere all stall at ~250 u (0.4-0.5%) by 76M with peak speed ~100-140 u/s: the yaw sigma inflates to the 2.718 clamp because the view entropy bonus is the Gaussian's, not the squashed action's (bang-bang look, often 180 deg off the velocity). Fix built: --view-ent-squash 1 (b47f38c, flag-off bit-identical). Running now: pbr1b3_vesq = recipe + --view-ent-squash 1 from scratch. Warm start from sid_ref walks to the same corner.
